statements.statement: The patient presents with exertional chest tightness and palpitations
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered
The study is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on coordination of benefits rules indicating care may be covered by another payer
